note: Execution/classification addendum written after the frozen per-document artifacts. It never mutates prediction/result/freeze bytes; it only labels what the run's execution outcome means.

DOC-0258.note: Reasoning-enabled full-context single-segment execution completed cleanly. F1=0.7391, systemInducedLoss=0. Valid ceiling result.

DOC-0205.note: Full-context (60,919 source chars, well inside the 262,144-token context window) single reasoning-enabled request did not return within 600s across 3 attempts (~30 min). This is a compute/latency/request-granularity finding, not a context-capacity finding and not a model quality finding -- it must not be scored as F1=0 or classified as MODEL_OMISSION. Two distinct ceiling concepts should be tracked going forward: MODEL_FULL_CONTEXT_CEILING (single whole-document reasoning-on request; FAILED_TIMEOUT here) vs EXECUTABLE_REASONING_CEILING (deterministic segmentation with reasoning still enabled, union of proposals, then global hierarchy) -- the latter is not implemented in this session and is recommended as separate follow-up work ('A99 QWEN9B REASONING EXECUTION RECOVERY').

DOC-0264.note: 224,731 source chars fit in one packet under the resolved token budget, so a single full-document request was attempted. The provider returned finish_reason=length with no content: reasoning consumed the entire 48,000-token completion budget before any final JSON was produced (PROVIDER_OUTPUT_LIMIT). A code fix was applied so this failure mode is now classified as PROVIDER_OUTPUT_LIMIT rather than a generic schema error, but source-faithful split-and-retry recovery for an output-limit failure was not implemented/re-run in this session. DOC-0264 was already expected to be exact-NOT_EVALUABLE under canonical Gold eligibility regardless of this execution outcome, so this does not change the DOC-0258/DOC-0205 exact scoring.

discrepancyFlag: DOC-0264 (224,731 chars) did not exhibit the same hang as DOC-0205 (60,919 chars) -- it failed fast on an output-limit rather than a 600s timeout. Document size alone does not explain execution outcome; a follow-up audit comparing request token counts and reasoning-token consumption across documents is recommended rather than assumed.
recommendedFollowUp: A99 QWEN9B REASONING EXECUTION RECOVERY: on FULL_CONTEXT_TIMEOUT or PROVIDER_OUTPUT_LIMIT, deterministically re-segment the source-faithful packet, run bounded (still reasoning-enabled) semantic calls per segment, union proposals, run the existing compact global hierarchy pass, then freeze/score. A segmented-recovery result must never be reported as a MODEL_FULL_CONTEXT_CEILING result.
